findings.title: basedOn.d300.role claims 'Last live heading at dispatch. Last-heading custody only.' D-300 is not the last live heading, and the subject's own purpose sentence asserts d334.role is the sole last-heading claimant. The file contradicts itself on its own bytes.
findings.location: docs/coop/artifacts/g21-fixture-corpus.v15.json basedOn.d300.role (first two sentences); contradicted by purpose ('basedOn.d334.role is the sole last-heading claimant.') and by basedOn.d334.role.
findings.measurement: basedOn.d300.role reads in full: 'Last live heading at dispatch. Last-heading custody only. Recorded anti-lockstep-hostile-goldens.v3 as DR-127 leftover-design fixture implementations. g21-fixture-corpus.v15 does not remasure anti-lockstep-leftover-join.v3 and does not steal OBL-HOSTILE-GOLDENS.' basedOn.d334.role opens with the identical two sentences. The last heading in live COORD (4b2bc7db…, the dispatched digest) is '## D-334 — Record g19 leftover-join.v10 as G19 leftover remasurement' at line 19865; D-300 sits at line 16866-. HEAD 12dbe3ba is the D-334 commit. Every other heading role in the same object is demoted explicitly: d324, d302, d301, d292 and d293 each end 'Last-heading custody remains D-334.' d300 alone is not.
findings.whyItIsAFinding: This is a false present-tense claim about live custody, not a historical statement. 'at dispatch' is anchored to this artifact's dispatch, and at this dispatch the last live heading is D-334, not D-300. The subject itself names the invariant it breaks: purpose states 'basedOn.d334.role is the sole last-heading claimant', and with d300.role carrying the same sentence there are two claimants, so the purpose sentence is false as written. A recorder reading basedOn to establish last-heading custody gets two mutually exclusive answers from one file.
findings.provenance: This is a mechanical carry-over from the g21-fixture-corpus.v11 cycle, where D-300 genuinely was the last live heading and the sentence was true. The accepted predecessor g21-fixture-corpus.v14 (D-302, dual ACCEPT 0/0) repaired it correctly, rewriting d300.role to open 'Recorded anti-lockstep-hostile-goldens.v3 as DR-127 leftover-design fixture implementations. Last-heading custody is D-301.' At v15 the speaker token inside the role was refreshed from g21-fixture-corpus.v14 to g21-fixture-corpus.v15 but the v11-era opening was restored, so this is a regression against an already-accepted repair in the same lineage, not a first-time slip.
findings.repair: Delete the first two sentences of basedOn.d300.role and demote it in the form the rest of the object already uses, e.g. 'Recorded anti-lockstep-hostile-goldens.v3 as DR-127 leftover-design fixture implementations. Not last-heading. Last-heading custody remains D-334. g21-fixture-corpus.v15 does not remasure the current anti-lockstep leftover remasurement and does not steal OBL-HOSTILE-GOLDENS.' No other cell needs to move; purpose then becomes true as written.

findings.whyItIsAFinding: authoredCatalog.standing declares the block disk-measured: 'AUTHORED-BYTES-EXIST. Digests recomputed from disk at dispatch.' doesNotMutate is the block's inventory of live fixture corpora the speaker leaves unmoved, and two of its twenty entries are corpora that were never authored. The claim is not merely vacuous: it asserts by inclusion that a g21.v13 and a g21.v14 fixture corpus exist, which invents two fixture directories out of the artifact-version numbering. It also makes remeasurementClause partly unverifiable, since a recorder asked to confirm those paths are unmoved cannot resolve them. Both accepted predecessors got this right: g21-fixture-corpus.v11 listed sixteen directories and g21-fixture-corpus.v14 listed seventeen, and every entry in both exists on disk. v15 is the first in the lineage to list paths that do not.
findings.whyNotMustFix: The clause is negative and the subject mutates nothing, so no live byte is endangered and no obligation is discharged on the strength of it. The graded harm is a false statement about the repository inside a block whose declared standing is disk measurement, which is honesty work a recorder should not have to carry.

observations.title: The authored bytes are unique across the entire fixture tree.
observations.measurement: Hashing every file under docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/ shows afa75181… occurring exactly once. The five repeated digests in the tree are the intended per-platform copy sets (9x, 8x, 7x, 5x, 5x). The new witness differs from the g21.v11 far-over prehandshake payload in its final octet only (01 00 00 00 vs 01 00 00 01), which is precisely the ceiling-plus-one relation the mutation text claims.

observations.title: Declining to pin a negotiated maxControlFrameBytes is the stronger choice, not an evasion.
observations.measurement: The quoted postHandshake clause makes the operative bound a negotiated field ranging over [65536, 16777216]. By choosing ceiling+1 the subject produces a witness that is RF-2 under every admissible negotiation, so the fixture needs no handshake state and no invented negotiated value. This is what lets whatIsNotAuthored honestly exclude a hello/helloAck body schema while still typing the refusal.

summaryForCoordinator: The authoring act is correct and I would accept it on its payload. G21.cc5.prefix-one-over-posthandshake is 01 00 00 01 = 16777217, exactly one over the ceiling quoted verbatim from control-protocol-contract.v2, unique across the fixture tree, not a reuse of the g21.v11 16777216 prefix, and named as a remaining injection by g21 leftover-join.v14 itself. All 70 cited digests recompute. All thirteen dispatched attacks fail to land. The bar is wording custody. basedOn.d300.role still opens with the g21-fixture-corpus.v11-era sentence 'Last live heading at dispatch. Last-heading custody only.', which is false at this dispatch (D-334 is) and makes the subject's own purpose sentence 'basedOn.d334.role is the sole last-heading claimant' false on the file's own bytes; the accepted predecessor v14 had already repaired this exact cell, so it is a regression. Separately, authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate lists fixtures/g21.v13/ and fixtures/g21.v14/, neither of which exists — the D-302 copies live under fixtures/g21.v12/ — inside a block that declares itself recomputed from disk. Both repairs are single-cell and touch no byte the subject authors.
